meaning: 门票仅在旅游服务处购买
usageNote: 告示牌专用句式！提醒游客别跑错地方买票，语气正式但超实用～

examples.en: Please note that tickets only available from tourist office on Main Street.
examples.zh: 请注意，门票仅在大街旅游服务处出售。

examples.en: The sign read: tickets only available from tourist office, so we rushed there before it closed.
examples.zh: 牌子上写着门票仅在旅游服务处购买，所以我们赶在关门前冲去了那里。
